prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Deliverable: isolated 3D model reference, one tree only, white background, entire tree visible, no base or extra objects.
Subject: Wide spreading oak with one broad emerald cushion canopy and two lower lobes. A sculpted toy-like tree: thick short trunk supporting TWO OR THREE HUGE SOLID SMOOTH CANOPY VOLUMES. Canopy surfaces continuous like inflated cushions, absolutely NO individual leaves, leaf cards, visible twigs, thin branches, spiky foliage or detailed leaf texture. 
Shape constraints: foliage must consist of 2 to 3 broad completely smooth continuous cloudlike masses, as if sculpted from clay; absolutely NO modeled or painted leaf patterns, leaf tips, branches poking through or canopy spikes. Plain matte continuous colors with soft subtle shading. The tree trunk ends flat at its base with NOTHING underneath it: no ground, no soil, no stones, no pot, no platform.
Camera: three quarter frontal view, low perspective distortion.
Lighting: soft neutral diffuse studio light, no sharp baked highlights.
No text, no watermark, no UI.
